acquirer.name: BSP Asset Acquisition I, LLC (an affiliate of Benefit Street Partners L.L.C.)

listed_quote.quote: it has entered into an asset purchase agreement with an affiliate of Benefit Street Partners L.L.C.

announcement.quote: TRIANGLE CAPITAL CORPORATION ANNOUNCES SALE OF INVESTMENT PORTFOLIO AND SIMULTANEOUS EXTERNALIZATION TRANSACTION

deals.notes: Not a merger of two listed funds. Triangle Capital Corporation (NYSE: TCAP, a BDC) agreed to sell its portfolio to a Benefit Street Partners affiliate and, simultaneously, to externalize under Barings LLC (an investment adviser, not a fund); the filings show no share-exchange merger. For completeness: the Asset Sale closed on July 31, 2018 (8-K 0001379785-18-000050: 'The Asset Sale closed on July 31, 2018.') and the externalization closed on August 2, 2018 (8-K 0001379785-18-000067), after stockholders approved both on July 24, 2018 (8-K 0001379785-18-000045); the company was renamed Barings BDC, Inc. (NYSE: BBDC). The buyer's listing status is inferred only from its description as an LLC affiliate of an asset manager; no filing states it is unlisted.

problems: No fund-to-fund merger is described; the only proposed transactions are an asset sale to an adviser's affiliate and an externalization. Recorded as one non-listed-pair deal; the buyer is not shown to be a closed-end fund or BDC.
